TWO CRITICAL BACKEND BUGS discovered: (1) stripe.checkout.Session objects returned by retrieve()/construct_from() do NOT support `.get()` in this stripe-python version → template_market.py:313 `s.get('status')` and billing.py:463 `obj.get('id')` both raise AttributeError. This breaks the ENTIRE iteration-81 CRITICAL FIX — the webhook fallback 500s on any well-formed unsigned event, AND the reconciler + /market/checkout/status polling cannot process paid sessions even when the emergent proxy successfully returns them. Backend logs confirm: '[market] session status retries exhausted ...: get' and stack trace 'AttributeError: get' at billing.py:463. (2) safeNextPath() in AppShell.jsx has side effects (localStorage.removeItem) inside render body; React StrictMode double-invokes render, so 1st call consumes the value + returns nextPath (but Navigate is discarded), 2nd call returns null → user stays on /chats. DID NOT re-run the real 4242-card Stripe checkout because bugs #1 above guarantee the confirmation flow cannot complete even if the payment succeeds (same root cause as iteration 80, now compounded by the .get() bug). Also verified raj's iteration-80 pending session cs_test_a1gQwSeCK... is still 'initiated' in DB (reconciler ran but crashed on .get; also the emergent proxy 404s the session most of the time due to load balancing).

critical.issue: stripe.checkout.Session objects returned by stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve() and stripe.Event.construct_from() do NOT have a `.get()` method in the installed stripe-python version — attribute access raises AttributeError. This breaks: (a) the webhook unsigned-payload fallback path (billing.py stripe_webhook line 463 `obj.get('id')` → 500 on ANY unsigned event received in emergent-proxy mode); (b) the market payment status endpoint (template_market.py _session_status_with_retry line 313 `s.get('status') or 'open'` → AttributeError caught but treated as retry-failure, so paid sessions NEVER resolve to 'paid' even when the proxy returns 200); (c) the 30s market reconciler (same .get() call in _session_status_with_retry) never confirms any pending payment. Repro: `stripe.checkout.Session.construct_from({'id':'x','status':'complete','payment_status':'paid'}, 'sk_test_x').get('status')` → AttributeError: get. Fix: replace ALL `s.get(k)` with dict subscript `s[k]` (StripeObject supports __getitem__) or use `dict(s).get(k)` / `s.to_dict_recursive().get(k)`. This is THE root cause blocking iteration-80's CRITICAL FIX + iteration-81's follow-up.

minor.issue: Also 500s on malformed but syntactically valid JSON (e.g., missing data.object) because event['data']['object'] raises KeyError with no handler. Should return 400 for any malformed event, not 500.

ui_bugs.issue: Side effect (localStorage.removeItem) inside render body. Under React.StrictMode (index.js:8), render is double-invoked in dev — first call consumes tn-next-path from localStorage and returns nextPath, but the resulting Navigate is discarded by StrictMode's throwaway pass; second call reads null and returns null → no navigation. Verified end-to-end: logged-out click 'Use this template' → /signup → login as amit → landed on /chats NOT /market/install/{id}; localStorage.tn-next-path IS set correctly and IS consumed, but the redirect never commits. Fix: move safeNextPath into a useState initializer (only runs once during commit) OR into a useEffect that reads-and-clears and calls navigate(...). Do NOT do the removeItem inline in render.

rca of the issue:
TWO INDEPENDENT ROOT CAUSES BLOCKING ITERATION 81's HEADLINE CRITICAL FIX:

(1) StripeObject.get() bug (BACKEND, CRITICAL): The installed stripe-python version's `StripeObject.__getattr__` raises AttributeError for attributes not in the underlying _data dict — INCLUDING inherited dict methods like `.get`. Both `template_market.py:313 s.get('status')` (the reconciler + status polling core) and `billing.py:463 obj.get('id')` (the webhook fallback core) crash with AttributeError: 'get'. Confirmed live via `python3 -c 'stripe.checkout.Session.construct_from({...},key).get("status")'` → AttributeError. Fix: replace `s.get(k)` with `s[k]` (StripeObject supports __getitem__ via dict subclassing) or `dict(s).get(k)` for a safe-with-default idiom. This bug makes iteration-80's original 'session retrieve 404' RCA a red herring for the parsing failures — even the 200-response path was crashing on .get().

(2) React StrictMode + render-side-effect bug (FRONTEND, HIGH): `AppShell.jsx:28 const nextPath = safeNextPath();` inline in render, with safeNextPath performing `localStorage.removeItem(...)`. React.StrictMode (index.js:8) intentionally double-invokes function-component render bodies in dev to expose non-idempotent code. First call reads 'tn-next-path' from localStorage, removes it, returns the value → Navigate scheduled. Second call reads null (already removed) → returns null → no Navigate. Because StrictMode's first render is discarded before commit, the scheduled Navigate never applies. Fix: move to useState(() => safeNextPath()) so the init function runs exactly once during commit, OR to useEffect where side effects belong.

Both fixes are simple (10 lines each) but until they land, the iteration-81 CRITICAL FIX + tn-next-path claims are non-functional.
